question: India is associated with which trade bloc of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is** "SAARC". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **The South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC)** is the intergovernmental and geopolitical organization of states of South Asia.
 
• Members of SAARC- Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka.
 
• This was founded in** Dhaka on 8 December 1985.**
 
• **Objective** - To promote economic development and regional integration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **OPEC** - Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries was founded on 14 September 1960 in Baghdad.

 
 
• The first five members of this organization are Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, and Venezuela. It is a permanent, intergovernmental organization.
 
• The headquarters of this organization is in **Vienna, Austria. **
 
 
 
• **NAFTA** - North American Free Trade Agreement signed by Canada, Mexico, and the United States.
 
 
• This agreement came into force on January 1, 1994. This treaty protects** intellectual property rights.**
 
 
 
• **FTA** - Free Trade Agreements. The United States has 14 Free Trade agreements with 20 countries.
 
 
• This agreement will help in advancing trade liberalization beyond World Trade Organization.
